2608.03691.title: Pattern over Pixels: Measuring Pattern Completion Bias in Multimodal Code Generation
2608.03691.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to translate webpage screenshots into front-end code, but repeated UI patterns may sway them toward visually incorrect yet pattern-consistent outputs. In this work, we test how repeated webpage patterns hurt MLLM accuracy on an objective screenshot-to-code fill-in-the-blank task. We introduce the first benchmark for visual pattern-completion bias, where one localized element in a repeated UI pattern is perturbed and the model must recover the masked width or font-size value from the screenshot and HTML context. Starting from 30 webpages curated from the Design2Code dataset, we build 1,440 evaluated screenshots spanning structural card and text-style patterns under standard and noise-overlaid conditions. We evaluate five frontier MLLMs and find that all are strongly biased toward the repeated baseline. Mean bias rate reaches 69.78% on card-width perturbations and 80.22% on text font-size perturbations, while mean accuracy is only 21.17% and 7.89%, respectively. Codex-5.3 performs best but still drops from 68.61% accuracy on cards to 13.89% on text, while Flash-3.0 reaches 96.11% bias on text. Noise, subtler perturbations, and boundary positions further increase bias rate. Reasoning analysis further shows that greater reasoning effort correlates with lower bias, yet qualitative evidence reveals that models can identify the anomalous element and still override it with the pattern-consistent answer. Our results identify a concrete failure mode in multimodal code generation and show that its severity is strongly associated with visual saliency
2608.03691.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）越來越多地用於將網頁截圖翻譯成前端代碼，但重複的用戶界面模式可能會使它們產生視覺上不正確但模式一致的輸出。在這項工作中，我們測試了重複的網頁模式如何影響 MLLM 在一個客觀的截圖到代碼填空任務中的準確性。我們引入了第一個視覺模式完成偏差的基準，其中在重複的用戶界面模式中一個局部元素被擾動，模型必須從截圖和 HTML 上下文中恢復被遮蔽的寬度或字體大小值。我們從 Design2Code 數據集中精選了 30 個網頁，構建了 1,440 個評估的截圖，涵蓋了結構性卡片和文本樣式模式，在標準和噪音疊加條件下進行。 我們評估了五個前沿的 MLLMs，發現它們都強烈偏向於重複的基準。卡片寬度擾動的平均偏差率達到 69.78%，而文本字體大小擾動的平均偏差率達到 80.22%，而平均準確率僅為 21.17% 和 7.89%。Codex-5.3 的表現最佳，但在卡片上的準確率從 68.61% 降至 13.89% 的文本，而 Flash-3.0 在文本上達到 96.11% 的偏差。噪音、更微妙的擾動和邊界位置進一步增加了偏差率。推理分析進一步顯示，較大的推理努力與較低的偏差相關，但定性證據顯示模型可以識別異常元素，卻仍然用模式一致的答案覆蓋它。我們的結果識別了多模態代碼生成中的具體失敗模式，並顯示其嚴重性與視覺顯著性強烈相關。
